notes.title: Artisan Story: Grow Together with the Relationship Update!
notes.content:
Hey, Artisans!
We’ve been hard at work adding new features, improving existing systems, and polishing the world of Artisan Story. This update brings new mechanics, quality-of-life upgrades, and visual improvements to enhance your adventures.


New Feature: Heart Event
Experience Heart Events 1 & 2 – Spend time with your favorite townsfolk, give gifts, and share conversations to grow closer. Once a heart fills, you’ll get a sweet invitation through the new Messenger App, your choices in the event will shape your relationship.

Added Heart Events to deepen relationships with townsfolk.

Unlocking a Heart Event:

Build Heart Points through quests, conversations, or gifts.

Fill a heart on the Relationship App.

Sleep to receive a message the next day to receive Heart Event invitations.

Dialogue choices during Heart Events can raise or lower Heart Levels.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/6d8101e0e7351f68cdfd138e90b2a086d30bb3d4.gif"]


New Feature: Monster Party System
Tame a creature, bond with them, and invite them into your party. Your monster friends can follow you, help gather items, and even carry their own inventory, making every adventure a little more fun.

You can now bring your ranch monsters along on your adventures.

Monsters can assist in foraging, exploring, and hunting.

To add a monster to your party:

Visit Breezefall Glades Dungeon and tame a monster.

Raise 3 Friendship Hearts with them by bonding and caring

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/ea3220bb9c3f1a197c04ba494cc816daa1ad4859.gif"]



Interact with them in your barn and select "Invite to Team".

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/07a5dfe3b7a4877e6ce7d0edb9c578e88dd5c428.gif"]



Party monsters can:

Follow you around the world.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/c500982371ccdd30d6c5bbf73ab4d8761f16c40d.gif"]



Help carry items with their own inventory.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/524e1a1ec2b668e2dccde9358d1db068c2a9aa43.gif"]



Be sent back to the barn.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/e2a613c409dfcafe483494f05b71adfdc4f87d11.gif"]


New Monster: Jell
A slimy, lovable companion that can now be tamed and added to your barn.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/f477838665e70d78fe8cc95a4e1570427838c386.gif"]


Additional Improvements
Added Key binds UI in the Settings (Keyboard only for now).

Grass & Foliage Overhaul: New grass texture and improved foliage shading for a fresher, more vibrant world.

New shops and items: Maple's Diner, Josephine's Store, and Clinic are open for business.


What’s Next?
We’re already working on future content, including:

Upgrades for the barn and other related systems

More Heart Events and more surprises!

We’d love to hear your thoughts, bug reports, or suggestions. Share them with us on Discord or Twitter; your feedback truly helps shape the world of Artisan Story.

Thank you again for playing and supporting us. We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it!



With love,
Adventroupe Studio

notes.title: Artisan Story: Reel in the Fun with Our Fishing Update!
notes.content:
Hello, Artisans!
We're thrilled to bring you our first big content update in Early Access: the Fishing Update! This update includes exciting new features like a fully playable fishing system, daily quests, new tracking apps, and improvements to foods. Here's a full breakdown of what’s new:

New Mechanic: Fishing
You can now fish across Humforte! Cast your line from the Town Square Deck or head to the waters near Breezefall Glades. Catch reef tuna, sardines, and more—there are 8 species to discover so far, and they can be sold, eaten, and gifted.

How It Works:

 Craft a Fishing Rod at the Forge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/75f7777a0f5f631f16acdb2bf8b37a139b418ab7.jpg
 Stand near a Fishing Spot (you'll see a hand cursor) and click the water to cast.
 Once a fish bites, a minigame begins:
 Hold Right Mouse Button to move the marker.
 Try to align it with colored zones (Green, Yellow, Red) on the bar.
 Tap Left Mouse Button when aligned to lower the fish’s stamina.
 Red zones = strongest hits. Miss too often and the fish escapes!
 When the stamina bar is depleted—you’ve caught it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/1501adcbe9f9f56fdaa79b455eafcf2738e07a2a.gif


New Feature: Daily Quests
Check the Town Quest Board for fresh tasks every day!

 These quests come from townsfolk who need your help.
 Completing them rewards you with Erils and boosts relationships.
 To refresh quests, simply sleep and check again the next day.
 It’s a great way to add rhythm to your days and deepen your connection to the village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/b33b5c7598ef8fc280e11286cb434be5322fe765.gif


New Feature: Relationship App
Want to know how close you are to the townsfolk?

 Press ‘P’ and look for ‘Relationship’
 Use the new Relationship App to view all discovered villagers.
 Track your relationship level and view character info.
 Note: Because this system is new, your past progress has been reset. Think of it as a fresh start to get even closer with your favorite villagers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/cc5b5509691276269eccd27b6254ed0c00a9ae21.gif


New Feature: Bestiary App
Keep track of all the monsters you’ve met around Clover Island:

 Press ‘P’ and look for ‘Bestiary’
 Each monster has 3 research stages: You can walk close to them, defeat or capture them to progress.
 View drop items, stat traits, and tiny lore blurbs for each creature.
 Perfect for collectors, tamers, and lore-lovers alike!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/9555435ba6827fd9ac47d0bf621471f4fdc242af.gif


Improved Food System
Foods are now more meaningful than ever:

 Meals and edibles now grant stat boosts.
 Each food has a saturation value, limiting how much stat you can boost daily.
 Saturation resets after sleeping.
 You’ll now need to think about what you eat and when, adding more strategy to daily life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386431/74869d31960e83afda27e30a2a28d224a32b8fe2.gif


Additional Improvements

 Adjusted overall light level for better visibility
 Added more resolution options in Settings.
 Add a recipe in Kaina's shop
 Added townsfolk gifting responses


Bugfix

 Fixed several missing points in NPC schedules
 Fixed player duplicating item by equipping them using drag and drop from the hotbar
 Fixed issue with dialogue
 Fixed issue in saving changes made to the field
 Fixed loading not resetting ui
 Fixed dialogue suddenly closing before it finishes
 Fixed camera suddenly disconnected from the player


What’s Next?
We’re already working on future content, including:

 Game performance improvements
 Heart Events and more!

We’d love to hear your thoughts, bug reports, or suggestions. Share them on Discord or Steam—your feedback helps shape the world of Artisan Story.

Thank you again for playing and supporting us. We hope you love this new update as much as we loved making it!

With love,
Adventroupe Studio

notes.title: Early Access Patch 0.0.2 - Bug Fixes and Improvements - April 18
notes.content:
Additions and Changes

 Added unstuck button
 Changed strength base status to 30
 Changed rune base status to 30
 Changed constitution base status to 30
 Feeding trough now show feed when feed is assigned through the barn menu
 Tamed animals now have an indicator showing they can be petted / collect resource from
 Any energy consumed beyond 0 will be dealt as damage to health
 Hotbar is changed from being a shortcut to an item in inventory to its own inventory slot
 Combat against monsters won't use energy
 Added confirmation for deleting save file
 Changed save and load UI


Bugfix

 Fixed player unable to craft after losing fried egg during tutorial
 Fixed player unable to leave Breezefall Glades after skipping combat tutorial
 Fixed crafting UI dissapearing after tutorial
 Fixed issue with dialogue
 Fixed issue in saving changes made to the field
 Fixed hotbar not getting saved
 Fixed loading a save that has finished the tutorial while in the tutorial making the other save in the tutorial
 Fixed time not being loaded correctly
 Fixed animal getting stuck when being sent outside and then changing the animal's name
 Fixed item icon having a weird offset when getting dragged by mouse
 Fixed map collisions
 Adjusted palm tree collision
 Fixed cooking item sell price
 Fixed player getting stuck when they gift nothing to townfolks
 Fixed growth book only getting updated when changing category


Found a Bug? Got Feedback?
If you encounter any bugs during gameplay or have any feedback to share, please let us know!

How to Share Your Feedback or Report a Bug:
Join our Discord now
